name: tehtris-edr
label: TEHTRIS EDR
description: TEHTRIS EDR (Endpoint Detection and Response) is designed to detect, analyze, and respond to security incidents on endpoints (such as computers, servers, and mobile devices) in real time.

fields.title: Server URL
fields.description: Specify the URL of the TEHTRIS EDR server to connect and perform automated operations.
fields.name: server_url
fields.tooltip: Specify the URL of the TEHTRIS EDR server to connect and perform automated operations.

fields.title: Password
fields.description: Specify the password to connect to the endpoint and perform automated operations
fields.name: password
fields.tooltip: Specify the password to connect to the endpoint and perform automated operations

fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.description: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified. By default, this option is selected, i.e., set to true.
fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.tooltip: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified. By default, this option is selected, i.e., set to true.

operations.title: Fetch Events
operations.description: Fetch events from the TEHTRIS EDR based on the filter criteria that you have specified.

parameters.title: From Date
parameters.description: Specify the timestamp (in seconds since EPOCH) to define the starting point for fetching events.
parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.tooltip: Specify the starting date in seconds since EPOCH.

parameters.title: To Date
parameters.description: Specify the timestamp (in seconds since EPOCH) to define the end point for fetching events.
parameters.name: toDate
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ending date in seconds since EPOCH.

parameters.title: Event ID
parameters.description: Specify the unique event ID to fetch details for a specific event.
parameters.name: eventId
parameters.tooltip: Specify the unique event ID to fetch details for a specific event.

parameters.title: Count Only
parameters.description: Select whether to count alerts only instead of retrieving the full list of events.
parameters.name: countOnly
parameters.tooltip: Select whether to count alerts only instead of retrieving the full list of events.

parameters.title: By Tag
parameters.description: Select whether to count alerts by their associated tags when count Only is enabled.
parameters.name: byTag
parameters.tooltip: Select whether to count alerts by their associated tags when count Only is enabled.

parameters.title: Filter ID
parameters.description: Specify the filter ID to use for retrieving events. If none is provided, the first filter associated with the API key will be used.
parameters.name: filterID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the filter ID to use for retrieving events. If none is provided, the first filter associated with the API key will be used.

parameters.title: Created or Modified
parameters.description: Select whether to fetch events based on their creation time or last modification time.
parameters.name: createdOrModified
parameters.tooltip: Select whether to fetch events based on their creation time or last modification time.

parameters.title: Offset
parameters.description: Specify the number of events to skip before starting to retrieve results, useful for pagination.
parameters.name: offset
parameters.tooltip: If Count Only is false, the number of events to skip before starting to retrieve results, useful for pagination.

parameters.title: Limit
parameters.description: Specify the maximum number of events to fetch, up to a limit of 1000.
parameters.name: limit
parameters.tooltip: Specify the maximum number of events to fetch, up to a limit of 1000.

operations.title: List Folders and Filters
operations.description: Retrieve a list of all folders and all filters the user has access to (as owner, editor or viewer) from TEHTRIS EDR based on the filter criteria that you have specified.

parameters.title: Name
parameters.description: Specify the name or partial name to filter and return only folders and filters that contain this value.
parameters.name: name
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name or partial name to filter and return only folders and filters that contain this value.

parameters.title: Module
parameters.description: Specify the module name to return only filters related to that specific module.
parameters.name: module
parameters.tooltip: Specify the module name to return only filters related to that specific module.

parameters.title: Old Filter ID
parameters.description: Specify the old filter ID to search for filters that were migrated from releases prior to version 10.1.
parameters.name: oldFilterId
parameters.tooltip: Specify the old filter ID to search for filters that were migrated from releases prior to version 10.1.

parameters.title: Filters Only
parameters.description: Select whether to return only filters, leaving the folder list empty.
parameters.name: filtersOnly
parameters.tooltip: Select whether to return only filters, leaving the folder list empty.

parameters.title: Preset Filters
parameters.description: Select whether to include preset filters in addition to the user’s own filters.
parameters.name: presetFilters
parameters.tooltip: Select whether to include preset filters in addition to the user’s own filters.

operations.title: Get Filter by ID
operations.description: Retrieve a filter by its unique ID from the TEHTRIS EDR platform.

parameters.title: Filter ID
parameters.description: Specify the unique filter ID to retrieve the corresponding filter details.
parameters.name: filterId
parameters.tooltip: Specify the unique filter ID to retrieve the corresponding filter details.

parameters.title: With History
parameters.description: Select whether to retrieve the filter along with its historical versions and changes.
parameters.name: withHistory
parameters.tooltip: Select whether to retrieve the filter along with its historical versions and changes.

operations.title: Create Filter
operations.description: Create a new filter in the TEHTRIS EDR platform based on specified parameters.

parameters.title: Name
parameters.description: Specify the name for the new filter. The name should clearly describe the purpose or scope of the filter.
parameters.name: name
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name for the new filter. The name should clearly describe the purpose or scope of the filter.

parameters.title: Minimum Severity Level
parameters.description: Specify the minimum severity level that this filter should capture, where 0 represents the least severe and 9 the most severe.
parameters.name: lvlmin
parameters.tooltip: Minimum severity level to be filtered (0-9)

parameters.title: Maximum Severity Level
parameters.description: Specify the maximum severity level that this filter should capture, where 0 represents the least severe and 9 the most severe.
parameters.name: lvlmax
parameters.tooltip: Maximum severity level to be filtered (0-9)

parameters.title: Description
parameters.description: Specify the description for the filter.
parameters.name: description
parameters.value: Filter autocreated by FortiSOAR for playbook ingestion, based on severity level.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the description for the filter.

parameters.title: Module
parameters.description: Specify the module to which this filter applies.
parameters.name: module
parameters.tooltip: Specify the module to which this filter applies.

operations.title: Update Filter
operations.description: Update an existing filter in the TEHTRIS EDR platform by modifying its parameters or attributes.

parameters.title: Filter ID
parameters.description: Specify the unique filter ID for the filter you want to update.
parameters.name: filterId
parameters.tooltip: Specify the unique ID of the filter to be updated.

parameters.title: Name
parameters.description: Specify the updated name for the filter. The name should clearly represent the filter’s purpose.
parameters.name: name
parameters.tooltip: Specify the new name for the filter being updated.

parameters.title: Minimum Severity Level
parameters.description: Specify the minimum severity level that the filter should capture, where 0 is the least severe and 9 is the most severe.
parameters.name: lvlmin
parameters.tooltip: Minimum severity level to be filtered (0-9)

parameters.title: Maximum Severity Level
parameters.description: Specify the maximum severity level that this filter should capture, where 0 represents the least severe and 9 the most severe.
parameters.name: lvlmax
parameters.tooltip: Maximum severity level to be filtered (0-9)

parameters.title: Description
parameters.description: Specify the updated description for the filter to provide context about its purpose or criteria.
parameters.name: description
parameters.tooltip: Specify the description of the filter to explain its purpose or context.

parameters.title: Tag
parameters.description: Specify the tag associated with the filter to update.
parameters.name: tag
parameters.tooltip: Specify the tag associated with the filter to update.

parameters.title: Device Name
parameters.description: Specify the name of the device associated with this filter to update.
parameters.name: deviceName
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the device associated with this filter to update.

parameters.title: Path
parameters.description: Specify the relevant file path if applicable to update the filter.
parameters.name: path
parameters.tooltip: Specify the relevant file path if applicable to update the filter.

parameters.title: CMD Line
parameters.description: Specify the command line value associated with this filter to update.
parameters.name: cmdline
parameters.tooltip: Specify the command line value associated with this filter to update.

parameters.title: SHA256
parameters.description: Specify the SHA-256 hash that may be tied to the filter for identification or verification purposes.
parameters.name: sha256
parameters.tooltip: Specify the SHA-256 hash that may be tied to the filter for identification or verification purposes.

parameters.title: Event Name
parameters.description: Specify the event name related to the filter to update.
parameters.name: eventName
parameters.tooltip: Specify the event name related to the filter to update.

parameters.title: EG Knowledge Base ID
parameters.description: Specify the EG knowledge base ID associated with the filter to update.
parameters.name: egKBId
parameters.tooltip: Specify the EG knowledge base ID associated with the filter to update.

parameters.title: Module
parameters.description: Select the applicable module for the filter. By default, it is set to "Endpoint".
parameters.name: module
parameters.tooltip: Select the applicable module for the filter. By default, it is set to "Endpoint".

operations.title: Delete Filter
operations.description: Delete an existing filter from the TEHTRIS EDR platform using its unique identifier.

parameters.title: Filter ID
parameters.description: Specify the filter ID corresponding to the filter that should be removed from the system.
parameters.name: filterId
parameters.tooltip: Specify the unique ID of the filter you want to delete.

operations.title: Set an event status
operations.description: Update the status of a specific event in the TEHTRIS EDR platform. The "Old Status" field can optionally be used to verify the current status before updating, or set to null to skip verification.

parameters.title: Event ID
parameters.description: Specify the event ID corresponding to the event you want to update in the TEHTRIS EDR platform.
parameters.name: id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the unique identifier (ID) of the event whose status needs to be updated.

parameters.title: New Status
parameters.description: Select the new status to assign to the event. Possible values include 'checked', 'false positive', 'incident', 'on going', 'pending', and 'resolved'.
parameters.name: status
parameters.tooltip: Select the new status to assign to the event. Possible values include 'checked', 'false positive', 'incident', 'on going', 'pending', and 'resolved'.

parameters.title: Old Status
parameters.description: Specify the current status of the event to verify before updating. Use null to bypass the old status check.
parameters.name: oldStatus
parameters.tooltip: Specify the current (old) status of the event before updating. Use null to skip verification.

operations.title: Get All Endpoints
operations.description: Retrieve all endpoints managed by the TEHTRIS EDR platform, with optional filters such as tags, hostnames, domains, IP ranges, OS versions, and time-based parameters.

parameters.title: Tags
parameters.description: Provide the list of tags to filter endpoints. Example: ["ABC_TEST", "DEF_TEST"].
parameters.name: tags
parameters.tooltip: Filter endpoints by tags. Example: ["ABC_TEST", "DEF_TEST"].

parameters.title: Hostname
parameters.description: Specify the hostname of the endpoint to filter results.
parameters.name: hostname
parameters.tooltip: Filter endpoints by hostname.

parameters.title: Hostname Regex
parameters.description: Specify a regular expression to match endpoint hostnames.
parameters.name: hostnameRegex
parameters.tooltip: Filter endpoints by hostname using a regular expression.

parameters.title: Domain
parameters.description: Specify the domain name to filter endpoints.
parameters.name: domain
parameters.tooltip: Filter endpoints by domain name.

parameters.title: Domain Regex
parameters.description: Specify a regular expression to match endpoint domains.
parameters.name: domainRegex
parameters.tooltip: Filter endpoints by domain using a regular expression.

parameters.title: Network
parameters.description: Specify the local or remote IP address or network subnet to filter endpoints.
parameters.name: network
parameters.tooltip: Filter endpoints by network IP or subnet. Example: 192.168.0.142 or 192.168.0.0/24.

parameters.title: Versions
parameters.description: Provide the list of EDR versions to filter endpoints. Example: ["1.0.2", "1.1.0"].
parameters.name: versions
parameters.tooltip: Filter endpoints by EDR version. Example: ["1.0.2", "1.1.0"].

parameters.title: Config UUIDs
parameters.description: Provide the list of configuration UUIDs to filter endpoints. Example: ["uuid-123", "uuid-456"].
parameters.name: configUuid
parameters.tooltip: Filter endpoints by configuration UUIDs. Example: ["uuid-123", "uuid-456"].

parameters.title: UUIDs
parameters.description: Provide the list of endpoint UUIDs to filter results. Example: ["uuid-abc", "uuid-def"].
parameters.name: uuids
parameters.tooltip: Filter endpoints by their UUIDs. Example: ["uuid-abc", "uuid-def"].

parameters.title: Appliance IDs
parameters.description: Provide the list of appliance IDs to filter endpoints. If not specified, defaults to appliances where the user has access rights.
parameters.name: applianceIds
parameters.tooltip: Filter endpoints by appliance IDs. Defaults to appliances where the user has access rights. Example: ["appliance-001"].

parameters.title: First Seen From
parameters.description: Specify the start date-time for filtering endpoints based on when they were first seen.
parameters.name: firstSeenFrom
parameters.tooltip: Filter endpoints first seen after this date-time. Example: 2025-09-26T14:40:22.924Z.

parameters.title: First Seen To
parameters.description: Specify the end date-time for filtering endpoints based on when they were first seen.
parameters.name: firstSeenTo
parameters.tooltip: Filter endpoints first seen before this date-time. Example: 2025-09-26T14:40:22.924Z.

parameters.title: Last Seen From
parameters.description: Specify the start date-time for filtering endpoints based on when they were last seen.
parameters.name: lastSeenFrom
parameters.tooltip: Filter endpoints last seen after this date-time. Example: 2025-09-26T14:40:22.924Z.

parameters.title: Last Seen To
parameters.description: Specify the end date-time for filtering endpoints based on when they were last seen.
parameters.name: lastSeenTo
parameters.tooltip: Filter endpoints last seen before this date-time. Example: 2025-09-26T14:40:22.924Z.

parameters.title: OS
parameters.description: Provide the operating system filter in dictionary format. Example: {"windows": ["10", "8"], "linux": ["Ubuntu 18.04 bionic"]}.
parameters.name: os
parameters.tooltip: Filter endpoints by operating system. Example: {"windows": ["10", "8"], "linux": ["Ubuntu 18.04 bionic"]}.

parameters.title: Offset
parameters.description: Specify the offset value for pagination. The default value is 0.
parameters.name: offset
parameters.tooltip: Specify pagination offset. Default is 0.

operations.title: Get Isolation Status
operations.description: Retrieve the current network isolation status of a specific endpoint from the TEHTRIS EDR platform.

parameters.title: Appliance ID
parameters.description: Specify the appliance ID that manages the endpoint whose isolation status is being retrieved.
parameters.name: applianceId
parameters.tooltip: Specify the unique ID of the appliance managing the endpoint.

parameters.title: EDR UUID
parameters.description: Specify the EDR UUID corresponding to the endpoint whose isolation status you want to retrieve.
parameters.name: edrUuid
parameters.tooltip: Specify the UUID of the endpoint to check its isolation status.

operations.title: Send Isolation Action
operations.description: Send a network isolation command to a specific endpoint through the TEHTRIS EDR platform. This allows enabling, disabling, or whitelisting isolation rules on managed endpoints.

parameters.title: Appliance ID
parameters.description: Specify the appliance ID that manages the endpoint on which the isolation action will be performed.
parameters.name: applianceId
parameters.tooltip: Specify the unique ID of the appliance where the isolation action should be executed.

parameters.title: EDR UUID
parameters.description: Specify the EDR UUID corresponding to the endpoint targeted for the isolation command.
parameters.name: edrUuid
parameters.tooltip: Specify the UUID of the endpoint on which to perform the isolation action.

parameters.title: Isolation Action
parameters.description: Select the type of isolation action to perform — Enable, Disable, or Whitelist — based on the required isolation state of the endpoint.
parameters.name: isolationAction
parameters.tooltip: Select the isolation action to perform: "Enable" to block all connections except TEHTRIS and DNS, "Disable" to remove isolation, or "Whitelist" to allow specific traffic during isolation.

parameters.title: WhiteList
parameters.description: Specify the whitelist ruleset to apply during isolation, allowing specific connections or policies when soft isolation is active.
parameters.name: toWhitelist
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ruleset or IPs to whitelist when isolation is enabled or using the whitelist command.

parameters.title: Power
parameters.description: Select whether to use Soft isolation (policy-based) or Hard isolation (immediate enforcement without configuration).
parameters.name: power
parameters.tooltip: Select the isolation power mode: "Soft" applies the isolation policy, while "Hard" enforces it directly without configuration.

parameters.title: Persist
parameters.description: Select whether to queue the isolation action until the endpoint reconnects, ensuring execution even when the endpoint is temporarily disconnected.
parameters.name: persist
parameters.tooltip: Select whether the isolation action should persist if the endpoint is currently offline. If true, the action executes once the endpoint reconnects.

operations.title: Get All Global Policies
operations.description: Retrieve all global policies from the TEHTRIS EDR platform.

operations.title: Create New Global Policies
operations.description: Create or update global policies within the TEHTRIS EDR platform. This operation supports both upsert and downsert actions, depending on the selected method.

parameters.title: Upsert/Downsert
parameters.description: Select the HTTP method to define how the policy should be processed — "POST", to create a new policy (downsert) or "PUT" to update an existing one (upsert).
parameters.name: position
parameters.tooltip: Select the method for the operation. Use "POST" for downsert (insert new) or "PUT" for upsert (update existing).

parameters.title: Policy Data
parameters.description: Specify the complete JSON data defining the global policy, including configurations, parameters, and applicable rules.
parameters.name: policyData
parameters.tooltip: Specify the data payload for the new or updated global policy in JSON format.

operations.title: Get Tags
operations.description: Retrieve all tags from the TEHTRIS EDR platform.

operations.title: Update Endpoints Tags
operations.description: Update or assign specific tags to one or multiple endpoints managed by the TEHTRIS EDR platform.

parameters.title: EDR UUID List
parameters.description: Specify the list of EDR UUIDs representing the endpoints that will receive the new or updated tags.
parameters.name: edrUuidList
parameters.tooltip: Specify the list of endpoint UUIDs to which the tag updates will be applied. Format: ["UUID1", "UUID2", ...]

parameters.title: Tags
parameters.description: Specify the tag value to assign to the endpoints. The tag must follow the format 'XXX_tags', where 'XXX' is a trigram identifier.
parameters.name: tags
parameters.tooltip: Specify the tag string to apply, following the pattern XXX_tags (e.g., trigram followed by an underscore and the tag name).

operations.title: Get Access Logs
operations.description: Create a cursor and fetch the first batch of access log data from the TEHTRIS EDR platform. Access logs are displayed from the most recent to the least recent by default.

parameters.title: EDR UUID
parameters.description: Specify the UUID of the EDR endpoint from which access logs will be fetched.
parameters.name: edrUuid
parameters.tooltip: Specify the UUID of the endpoint whose access logs are to be retrieved.

parameters.title: Appliance ID
parameters.description: Specify the ID of the appliance that manages the target endpoint.
parameters.name: applianceId
parameters.tooltip: Specify the unique identifier of the appliance managing the endpoint.

parameters.title: Hostname
parameters.description: Specify the hostname filter for access logs. If omitted, the most recent hostname will be used.
parameters.name: hostname
parameters.tooltip: Specify the hostname to filter logs. The last known hostname is used by default if not provided.

parameters.title: Admin
parameters.description: Select whether to return only the count of alerts (True) or the full list of access logs (False).
parameters.name: admin
parameters.tooltip: Select whether to count alerts (True) instead of retrieving the full list (False).

parameters.title: Logon Event Time From
parameters.description: Specify the start timestamp for filtering access logs based on logon event time.
parameters.name: logonEventTimeFrom
parameters.tooltip: Specify the start of the logon event time range in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2025-09-26T14:40:22.924Z).

parameters.title: Logon Event Time To
parameters.description: Specify the end timestamp for filtering access logs based on logon event time. Must be later than "Logon Event Time From".
parameters.name: logonEventTimeTo
parameters.tooltip: Specify the end of the logon event time range in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2025-09-26T14:40:22.924Z). Must be later than "Logon Event Time From".

parameters.title: Limit
parameters.description: Specify the maximum number of access log entries to fetch in a single query. The value cannot exceed 1000.
parameters.name: limit
parameters.tooltip: Specify the maximum number of access logs to return (cannot exceed 1000).

parameters.title: Offset
parameters.description: Specify the number of records to skip before starting to retrieve access log results, for pagination purposes.
parameters.name: offset
parameters.tooltip: Specify the number of log entries to skip before returning results. Used for pagination.

operations.title: Get Users Connected
operations.description: Retrieve a list of users who have connected to a specified endpoint within the last 6 months using the TEHTRIS EDR platform.

parameters.title: EDR UUID
parameters.description: Specify the UUID of the EDR endpoint from which to retrieve connected user information.
parameters.name: edrUuid
parameters.tooltip: Specify the UUID of the endpoint whose connected users are to be retrieved.

parameters.title: Appliance ID
parameters.description: Specify the unique identifier of the appliance managing the endpoint.
parameters.name: applianceId
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the appliance managing the endpoint.

parameters.title: Hostname
parameters.description: Specify the hostname to filter connected users. If omitted, the latest known hostname will be used.
parameters.name: hostname
parameters.tooltip: Specify the hostname to filter results. The last known hostname is used by default if not specified.

parameters.title: Limit
parameters.description: Specify the maximum number of connected user records to retrieve in a single query. The limit cannot exceed 1000.
parameters.name: limit
parameters.tooltip: Specify the maximum number of connected users to return (cannot exceed 1000).

parameters.title: Offset
parameters.description: Specify the number of connected user entries to skip before returning results, for pagination purposes.
parameters.name: offset
parameters.tooltip: Specify the number of records to skip before returning results. Used for pagination.

operations.title: Get Network Information
operations.description: Retrieve detailed network information for a specified endpoint using the TEHTRIS EDR platform.

parameters.title: EDR UUID
parameters.description: Specify the UUID of the EDR endpoint for which to collect detailed network data.
parameters.name: edrUuid
parameters.tooltip: Specify the UUID of the endpoint whose network information you want to retrieve.

parameters.title: Appliance ID
parameters.description: Specify the unique appliance ID associated with the endpoint to retrieve its network details.
parameters.name: applianceId
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the appliance managing this endpoint.

parameters.title: Hostname
parameters.description: Specify the hostname to refine the network information query. Defaults to the latest hostname if omitted.
parameters.name: hostname
parameters.tooltip: Specify the hostname to filter results. The latest known hostname is used by default if not provided.

operations.title: Get Processes History
operations.description: Retrieve the historical list of processes executed on a specific endpoint within a defined time interval using the TEHTRIS EDR platform.

parameters.title: EDR UUID
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the endpoint (EDR) whose process history is being queried.
parameters.name: edrUuid
parameters.tooltip: Specify the UUID of the endpoint whose process history should be retrieved.

parameters.title: Appliance ID
parameters.description: Specify the ID of the appliance managing the specified endpoint.
parameters.name: applianceId
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the appliance managing this endpoint.

parameters.title: Process IDs
parameters.description: Filter for specific process IDs (PID list).
parameters.name: pids
parameters.tooltip: Filter on specific process IDs (array format).

parameters.title: Parent Process IDs
parameters.description: Filter for specific parent process IDs (PPID list).
parameters.name: ppids
parameters.tooltip: Filter on specific parent process IDs (array format).

parameters.title: Logon IDs
parameters.description: Filter for logon session identifiers linked to processes.
parameters.name: logonIds
parameters.tooltip: Filter on specific logon session identifiers (array format).

parameters.title: User Identifier
parameters.description: Filter by user identifier (SID on Windows, UID on Linux). Supports substring matching.
parameters.name: userIdentifier
parameters.tooltip: Filter by user identifier (SID on Windows, UID on Linux). Substring compatible.

parameters.title: Username
parameters.description: Filter results by username associated with the process.
parameters.name: username
parameters.tooltip: Filter by username. Substring compatible.

parameters.title: Domain Name
parameters.description: Filter processes based on the domain name. Supports substring matching.
parameters.name: domainName
parameters.tooltip: Filter by domain name. Substring compatible.

parameters.title: Local Time
parameters.description: If set to True, converts timestamps to the endpoint’s local time. Defaults to UTC.
parameters.name: localTime
parameters.tooltip: If true, converts timestamps to local time. Defaults to UTC if false.

parameters.title: Time Filter
parameters.description: Select which process lifecycle timestamp to filter by — Alive, Created, or Stopped.
parameters.name: timeFilter
parameters.tooltip: Choose which process time attribute to filter by.

parameters.title: Time From
parameters.description: Start of the time range for retrieving process history. Format: 2025-09-26T14:40:22.924Z.
parameters.name: timeFrom
parameters.tooltip: Start of the time range for process history. Format: 2025-09-26T14:40:22.924Z.

parameters.title: Time To
parameters.description: End of the time range for retrieving process history. Format: 2025-09-26T14:40:22.924Z.
parameters.name: timeTo
parameters.tooltip: End of the time range for process history. Format: 2025-09-26T14:40:22.924Z.

parameters.title: SHA256
parameters.description: Filter processes by their executable file’s SHA256 hash.
parameters.name: sha256
parameters.tooltip: Filter by file hash (SHA256).

parameters.title: SHA1
parameters.description: Filter processes by their executable file’s SHA1 hash.
parameters.name: sha1
parameters.tooltip: Filter by file hash (SHA1).

parameters.title: MD5
parameters.description: Filter processes by their executable file’s MD5 hash.
parameters.name: md5
parameters.tooltip: Filter by file hash (MD5).

parameters.title: Path
parameters.description: Filter processes based on the executable file path. Supports substring matching.
parameters.name: path
parameters.tooltip: Filter by executable file path. Substring compatible.

parameters.title: CMD Line
parameters.description: Filter processes by the command line arguments used when launching the process.
parameters.name: cmdline
parameters.tooltip: Filter by command line arguments used when launching the process.

parameters.title: Limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return. Value cannot exceed 1000.
parameters.name: limit
parameters.tooltip: Maximum number of results to return (cannot exceed 1000).

parameters.title: Offset
parameters.description: Number of records to skip before beginning to return results (for pagination).
parameters.name: offset
parameters.tooltip: Number of results to skip before starting to collect data (useful for pagination).

operations.title: Get Process Tree
operations.description: Retrieve the hierarchical process tree for a given process on a specific endpoint using the TEHTRIS EDR platform.

parameters.title: EDR UUID
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the endpoint (EDR) from which the process tree will be retrieved.
parameters.name: edrUuid
parameters.tooltip: Specify the EDR UUID of the endpoint.

parameters.title: Appliance ID
parameters.description: Specify the identifier of the appliance managing the target endpoint.
parameters.name: applianceId
parameters.tooltip: Specify the appliance ID of the appliance.

parameters.title: Process ID
parameters.description: The process ID (PID) used as the root of the process tree to be retrieved.
parameters.name: pid
parameters.tooltip: PID of the process used to build the tree.

parameters.title: Created Time
parameters.description: The local creation time of the process, used to identify it precisely. Format: 2025-09-26T14:40:22.924Z.
parameters.name: createTime
parameters.tooltip: Local created time of the process. Format date-time. 2025-09-26T14:40:22.924Z.

parameters.title: Number of Parents
parameters.description: Specifies how many parent processes should be included in the returned process tree hierarchy.
parameters.name: nbParents
parameters.tooltip: Number of parent processes to retrieve.

parameters.title: Limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of processes to retrieve in the tree. Cannot exceed 1000.
parameters.name: limit
parameters.tooltip: Maximum number of results to return (cannot exceed 1000).

parameters.title: Offset
parameters.description: Pagination offset for results. This parameter is deprecated and fixed to 0.
parameters.name: offset
parameters.tooltip: Offset is deprecated and locked to 0.

operations.title: Get Persistence Entries
operations.description: Retrieve persistence mechanisms (such as services, startup scripts, cron jobs, or configuration-based auto-start entries) detected on a specified Linux endpoint.

parameters.title: EDR UUID
parameters.description: Specify the unique identifier (UUID) of the endpoint as registered in the TEHTRIS EDR system.
parameters.name: edrUuid
parameters.tooltip: Provide the UUID assigned to the endpoint within the TEHTRIS EDR platform. This uniquely identifies the device being queried.

parameters.title: Appliance ID
parameters.description: Specify the numeric identifier of the TEHTRIS EDR appliance managing the specified endpoint.
parameters.name: applianceId
parameters.tooltip: Enter the appliance ID corresponding to the TEHTRIS EDR appliance that manages the endpoint.

parameters.description: List of directory paths to exclude from the scan (whitelisted).
parameters.name: scanWhitelistPaths
parameters.tooltip: Specify an array of file or folder paths to be excluded from the scan. Example: ["C:\\Windows", "C:\\Users"]

parameters.title: Start Folders
parameters.description: Define specific folders or drives where the scan should begin.
parameters.name: startFolders
parameters.tooltip: Provide an array of folder paths where the disk scan should start. Example: ["C:\\Windows", "C:\\Users"]

operations.title: Get Current Scan Status
operations.description: Retrieve the current scan status for a specific endpoint.

parameters.title: EDR UUID
parameters.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the endpoint as registered in the TEHTRIS EDR system.
parameters.name: edrUuid
parameters.tooltip: Provide the UUID of the endpoint for which you want to retrieve the scan status.

parameters.title: Appliance ID
parameters.description: The numeric identifier of the EDR appliance managing the specified endpoint.
parameters.name: applianceId
parameters.tooltip: Enter the ID of the appliance responsible for managing the target endpoint.

operations.title: Stop Current Scan
operations.description: Terminate an active disk scan for a specified endpoint.

parameters.title: EDR UUID
parameters.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the endpoint where the scan is running.
parameters.name: edrUuid
parameters.tooltip: Provide the UUID of the endpoint whose active scan you want to stop.

parameters.title: Appliance ID
parameters.description: The numeric identifier of the EDR appliance managing the specified endpoint.
parameters.name: applianceId
parameters.tooltip: Enter the appliance ID responsible for managing the endpoint.

operations.title: Get All Quarantine Files
operations.description: Retrieve the complete list of quarantined files detected on a specific endpoint.

parameters.title: EDR UUID
parameters.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the endpoint from which to retrieve quarantined files.
parameters.name: edrUuid
parameters.tooltip: Provide the UUID of the endpoint to identify which device’s quarantine list should be retrieved.

parameters.title: Appliance ID
parameters.description: The numeric identifier of the appliance managing the specified endpoint.
parameters.name: applianceId
parameters.tooltip: Enter the appliance ID responsible for managing the endpoint.

operations.title: Quarantine a File
operations.description: Remotely quarantine a specific file on an endpoint.

parameters.title: EDR UUID
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the endpoint on which the file quarantine operation will be executed.
parameters.name: edrUuid
parameters.tooltip: Provide the UUID of the endpoint to perform the quarantine operation.

parameters.title: Appliance ID
parameters.description: The numeric identifier of the appliance managing the target endpoint.
parameters.name: applianceId
parameters.tooltip: Specify the appliance ID responsible for the endpoint.

parameters.title: Path
parameters.description: The full path to the file that should be quarantined on the endpoint.
parameters.name: path
parameters.tooltip: Provide the complete file path, for example: 'C:\\Users\\John\\Documents\\suspicious.exe'.

parameters.title: Persist
parameters.description: Defines whether the task should be queued and executed when the endpoint reconnects if it is currently offline.
parameters.name: persist
parameters.tooltip: If set to 'True', the quarantine task will persist and execute automatically once the endpoint becomes available.

parameters.title: Notification
parameters.description: Custom message to display on the endpoint when the file is quarantined (Windows only).
parameters.name: notification
parameters.tooltip: Optional message displayed to the user on the endpoint upon quarantine action.

operations.title: Restore File from Quarantine
operations.description: Restore a previously quarantined file on a given endpoint.

parameters.title: EDR UUID
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the endpoint where the quarantined file should be restored.
parameters.name: edrUuid
parameters.tooltip: Provide the UUID of the endpoint where the restoration will be performed.

parameters.title: Appliance ID
parameters.description: The numeric identifier of the TEHTRIS appliance managing the target endpoint.
parameters.name: applianceId
parameters.tooltip: Specify the appliance ID responsible for the endpoint.

parameters.title: Path
parameters.description: The full path of the quarantined file to restore.
parameters.name: path
parameters.tooltip: Provide the exact file path to restore, for example: 'C:\\Quarantine\\test.txt'.

parameters.title: Persist
parameters.description: Defines whether the restore task should be queued and executed when the endpoint reconnects if it is currently offline.
parameters.name: persist
parameters.tooltip: If set to 'True', the restore task will persist and execute automatically once the endpoint becomes available.

operations.title: Get Unmanaged Hosts
operations.description: Retrieve a list of unmanaged hosts discovered on a specified appliance.

parameters.title: Appliance ID
parameters.description: The unique numeric identifier of the TEHTRIS appliance responsible for host discovery and management.
parameters.name: applianceId
parameters.tooltip: Enter the appliance ID of the TEHTRIS appliance from which to retrieve unmanaged hosts.

parameters.title: Last Seen From
parameters.description: Return unmanaged hosts that were last seen on or after this timestamp. Useful for time-based filtering of discovery results.
parameters.name: lastSeenFrom
parameters.tooltip: Specify the start of the last-seen time range in date-time format (e.g., 2025-09-26T14:40:22.924Z).

parameters.title: Last Seen To
parameters.description: Return unmanaged hosts that were last seen on or before this timestamp. The value must be later than 'Last Seen From' if both are provided.
parameters.name: lastSeenTo
parameters.tooltip: Specify the end of the last-seen time range in date-time format (e.g., 2025-09-26T14:40:22.924Z).

parameters.title: Limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return per request. The value must not exceed 10,000.
parameters.name: limit
parameters.tooltip: Set the maximum number of unmanaged hosts to retrieve (up to 10,000 per request).

parameters.title: Offset
parameters.description: The number of records to skip before starting to collect the result set. Used for pagination when more than 10,000 results are available.
parameters.name: offset
parameters.tooltip: Default is 0, used for pagination. If more than 10 000 results are found, call API another time by incrementing offset by 10 000 until less than 10 000 results are found.

operations.title: Execute an API Request
operations.description: Sends an API request to an API endpoint based on specified HTTP method, endpoint, and other input parameters that you have specified, enabling flexible API interactions tailored to user needs.

parameters.name: method
parameters.title: HTTP Method
parameters.description:
Select an HTTP action for the request. You can select from the following options:  

DELETE 

GET 

PATCH 

POST 

PUT

parameters.title: Endpoint
parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.tooltip: Specify the target API URL path for example: /api/edr/v2/inventory
parameters.description: Specify the target API URL path for the request. For example, if the website is https://example.com and URL path is https://example.com/images/pic.jpg, the endpoint would be /images/pic.jpg.

parameters.title: Query Parameters
parameters.name: query_params
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify any optional parameters to add to the URL and refine the request.

parameters.name: payload
parameters.title: Request Payload
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify data, as JSON, to be sent as the request payload (typically for POST or PUT requests).
